requestBudget.splitExecution: TRAIN/CAL first; TEST only after candidate artifact/policy is frozen and independently accepted. No mixed invocation or request refund.
requestBudget.policy: One robots and one TDM request per exact origin per invocation; normal fetcher, sequential max(5000ms, robots delay), no redirects/retries/subject replacements.
requestBudget.collectorChangeRequired: Current collector remains Wikipedia-only. Every new literal origin and ID requires source review before collection.
requestBudget.unavailableSupport: Retain unavailable rows; no waived minimums or replacements after predictions.

separation.legacyPublisherOverlap: Archived TRAIN and CAL share Wikimedia. Original splits and exact document groups are retained; no publisher-heldout or independent-population claim is made for reused data.
separation.targetConceptOverlap: Koala documents necessarily share the target species. Groups describe distinct editorial documents, not invented species or independent populations.
separation.withinSplitCorrelation: Two AKF TRAIN documents share a publisher. QLD CAL and NSW TEST each share governmental templates and related subjects. Counts are development support, not population confidence.
separation.nearDuplicateAudit: Before fit, compare TRAIN/CAL normalized URLs, editorial-document identities, exact body hashes and boilerplate-stripped paragraph/5-word-shingle overlap against one another and archived rosters. At TEST evaluation repeat fixed collision audit before scoring, never exposing TEST to fitting. Exact body equality, translations/editions of the same editorial document, or >=0.80 shingle containment in either direction quarantines connected families; ambiguous syndication requires review blind to predictions. For named-game identity tasks, repeated pages/ports/editions about the same game entity count as one group. Distinct koala biology/care documents are NOT duplicates merely because they concern the same species: shared species and publisher correlation remain explicit. Never move split or substitute subjects; surviving-support shortfall disables unsupported detail.
separation.testReservation: Fourteen TEST URLs are predeclared. Revision adds primary publisher search metadata only: no direct page open, saved TEST body read, capture, vector or prediction. Search results may return extended excerpts; no claim that no text was visible.
separation.knownHeldoutDocumentCollision: gta-train-03 reuses Grand Theft Auto IV, also root-expansion-final-001. Annotation is known but reuseEligible=false; historical roles remain explicit.
separation.collisionScope: Exact archived URL collisions checked against preserved root-expansion TEST and curated root-web metadata. New official URLs differ from those Wikipedia documents; all-future-corpus and syndication equivalence are not guaranteed.
separation.publisherUmbrellaRule: Treat NSW environment and national parks as one government publisher umbrella, TEST-only; all Queensland Government sites are CAL. Preserve original sourceFamily strings, but separate hostnames do not prove publisher independence.
